name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Styled Solid sheet component backed by Keystone modal overlay behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-sheet classes while Keystone owns focus, dismissal, pointer blocking, and side data.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical composes Dialog/Drawer-style overlay behavior with side metadata, backdrop/content parts, controlled open state, focus/dismissal, pointer blocking, and Mason side classes. Gaps: Base UI Drawer gesture depth, nested modal edge cases, transition status data, scroll lock polish, and responsive viewport geometry remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Kobalte has Dialog rather than a dedicated Sheet primitive; parity is through Solid dialog/dismissable-layer/focus-scope behavior. Gaps: create-transition parity, outside hiding ref counts, and route-navigation restoration remain follow-up work.
